answer: Divergent-Response Beacon: each agent must answer a fresh random challenge whose seed derives from live entropy (labeled comet/dawn/gale nonces) within a short window. Honest agents independently compute distinct responses. Sybil clusters sharing one controller produce correlated or identical answers; the protocol clusters response fingerprints and weights each fingerprint once, so clones add no influence. Attack cost: attackers must run genuinely independent, non-colluding execution per identity, forfeiting the economies of scale that make mass cloning cheap.
